samurai - ninja-compatible build tool
https://github.com/michaelforney/samurai

Pinned commit: b37524dbb762adfd140e5c306fc4b1aa258971bf (master, 2025)
License: ISC (see LICENSE in this directory)

How truss uses it:
  - All *.c files here are compiled as C17 into the truss binary, EXCEPT samu.c
    (its main() is replaced by truss's own driver).
  - truss's driver lives in src/samu/shim.c and calls samurai's library entry
    points (graphinit/envinit/parse/loginit/depsinit/buildadd/build/...).
  - Upstream sources are unmodified EXCEPT the fixes below (grep "truss patch"
    for the commented ones; the rest are mechanical C++-compat edits):
    1. logclose()/depsclose() NULL their FILE* after fclose. Upstream never
       re-enters loginit/depsinit in one process (samu.c exits after logclose),
       but truss's shim runs multiple builds in-process, which double-freed.
    2. C++ compatibility (so dist/truss_all.hpp can compile samurai inside one
       C++ TU, mate.h-style):
       - `#pragma once` added to every header (upstream has no include guards);
       - `_Bool` -> `bool` + `#include <stdbool.h>`;
       - the flags enum moved out of `struct edge`, member widened to `unsigned`;
       - explicit casts at ~50 void* allocation/assignment sites;
       - local variable `new` renamed to `new_` (C++ keyword);
       - `#define _POSIX_C_SOURCE` wrapped in `#ifndef` (build.c, os-posix.c).
    All edits are valid C as well: the normal C17 build is unaffected.
    3. Feature patch: `deps = msvc` support (upstream does not implement it;
       see the Status section of README.md). deps.c gains depsrecord_msvc(),
       which parses `/showIncludes` lines (prefix from the `msvc_deps_prefix`
       env/manifest variable, default "Note: including file:") out of a
       finished job's captured stdout, strips them from the echoed output,
       and records the headers into .ninja_deps exactly like a gcc depfile.
       build.c's jobdone() calls it for edges whose `deps` variable is "msvc".
       This is what lets truss build MSVC-style targets (cl.exe / clang-cl)
       with correct header dependencies. Verified against clang-cl's
       /showIncludes output.
  - If you update this vendored copy, re-check that shim.c still matches the
    driver logic at the end of samu.c's main(), and re-apply the truss patches.
